key: ANNA: you know the butterfly effect, right?
en: ANNA: you know the butterfly effect, right?
ja: アンナ: バタフライ効果って知ってる?

key: the flap of a butterfly's wings creates a hurricane on the other side of the world and all that...
en: the flap of a butterfly's wings creates a hurricane on the other side of the world and all that...
ja: チョウの羽ばたきが、地球の反対側でハリケーンを引き起こすとかいう、あれ……

key: you know what the worst thing about that is?
en: you know what the worst thing about that is?
ja: その中で一番最悪なことって、何だと思う?

key: it never stops.
en: it never stops.
ja: それが、絶対に止まらないってこと。

key: it's really easy to talk about and imagine how one little bug's wings at one particular moment in time could've done that...
en: it's really easy to talk about and imagine how one little bug's wings at one particular moment in time could've done that...
ja: ある一瞬の、一匹の小さな虫の羽が、それを引き起こしたって話すのも想像するのも簡単だけど……

key: but it's not just one bug-- not just one moment...
en: but it's not just one bug-- not just one moment...
ja: でも、一匹の虫だけじゃない――一瞬だけでもない……

key: even in just the moment since i've started talking, hundreds of millions-- no, billions of snap decisions have been made, each of which could have altered the course of history in innumerable ways...
en: even in just the moment since i've started talking, hundreds of millions-- no, billions of snap decisions have been made, each of which could have altered the course of history in innumerable ways...
ja: あたしがしゃべり始めてからのこの一瞬だけでも、何億――ううん、何十億もの瞬間的な決断が下されてて、そのどれもが、数えきれないほどのやり方で歴史を変えられたかもしれないんだよ……

key: so tell me...
en: so tell me...
ja: だから教えてよ……

key: how is it,
en: how is it,
ja: どうして、

key: that in each of these ever-reaching and uncountable timelines...
en: that in each of these ever-reaching and uncountable timelines...
ja: この果てしなく広がる、数えきれない時間軸のどれをとっても……

key: ...you're still such a steaming pile of poisonous garbage?
en: ...you're still such a steaming pile of poisonous garbage?
ja: ……あんたは相変わらず、湯気の立った毒入りゴミの山なわけ?

key: obviously i need to take matters into my own hands.
en: obviously i need to take matters into my own hands.
ja: 明らかに、あたしが自分の手で片をつけなきゃいけないみたいね。

key: dance for me?
en: dance for me?
ja: 踊ってよ?

key: music was meant to be faced.
en: music was meant to be faced.
ja: 音楽には、正面から向き合うものでしょ。

key: ANNA: maybe i should take a moment to practice being grateful for things!
en: ANNA: maybe i should take a moment to practice being grateful for things!
ja: アンナ: ちょっと、感謝の気持ちを実践してみる時間にしよっかな!

key: i hear that helps improve happiness and attitude if you make it a regular habit!
en: i hear that helps improve happiness and attitude if you make it a regular habit!
ja: 習慣にすると、幸福感や態度が良くなるんだって!

key: okay, here goes...
en: okay, here goes...
ja: よし、いくよ……

key: i'm very grateful that...
en: i'm very grateful that...
ja: あたしはすごく感謝してる、……

key: ...everyone else is not like you!
en: ...everyone else is not like you!
ja: ……あんた以外のみんなが、あんたみたいじゃないことに!

key: most kids look forward to small things, like getting a new bike, or snack time, or having a slumber party, right?
en: most kids look forward to small things, like getting a new bike, or snack time, or having a slumber party, right?
ja: 普通の子供たちって、新しい自転車をもらうとか、おやつの時間とか、お泊まり会とか、そういう小さなことを楽しみにしてるでしょ?

key: mostly they just want to be allowed to have fun.
en: mostly they just want to be allowed to have fun.
ja: だいたい、みんな楽しませてもらいたいだけなんだよ。

key: and maybe that's what you're doing too, in your own sick, roundabout way.
en: and maybe that's what you're doing too, in your own sick, roundabout way.
ja: で、たぶんあんたも、あんたなりの気持ち悪い遠回しなやり方で、同じことをしてるんでしょ。

key: but what is it you really want, lin???
en: but what is it you really want, lin???
ja: でも、あんたが本当に欲しいものって何なの、リン???

key: the end of a world-- the beginning of a new one?
en: the end of a world-- the beginning of a new one?
ja: 世界の終わり――新しい世界の始まり?

key: all that nonsense???
en: all that nonsense???
ja: そういうくだらないこと全部???

key: what is your end goal here???
en: what is your end goal here???
ja: あんたの最終目標って一体何なの???

key: tell me!!!
en: tell me!!!
ja: 教えてよ!!!

key: ANNA: come to think of it...
en: ANNA: come to think of it...
ja: アンナ: 考えてみれば……

key: ...what did i even want?
en: ...what did i even want?
ja: ……あたしは一体何が欲しかったんだろう?

key: i haven't had time to think about things like spending time with my friends and family,
en: i haven't had time to think about things like spending time with my friends and family,
ja: 友達や家族と過ごす時間について考える余裕なんて、全然なかった。

key: because i've been too busy fighting you.
en: because i've been too busy fighting you.
ja: あんたと戦うのに忙しすぎて。

key: ...is that what you wanted?
en: ...is that what you wanted?
ja: ……それが、あんたの望みだったの?

key: you just wanted someone to pay attention to you, right?
en: you just wanted someone to pay attention to you, right?
ja: 誰かに構ってほしかっただけなんでしょ?

key: ...but what about me?
en: ...but what about me?
ja: ……でも、あたしはどうなるの?

key: NOEL: \PN, should I pull you out?
en: NOEL: \PN, should I pull you out?
ja: ノエル: \PN、あなたを引き戻した方がいいですか?

key: NOEL: Okay, hold on.
en: NOEL: Okay, hold on.
ja: ノエル: わかりました、少し待ってください。

key: SIGMUND: I offer you, children, asylum.
en: SIGMUND: I offer you, children, asylum.
ja: シグムンド: 子供たちよ、私は君たちに、避難所を提供しよう。

key: ELIZABETH: An offer you have to take.
en: ELIZABETH: An offer you have to take.
ja: エリザベス: 受け入れなきゃいけない申し出、ね。

key: SIGMUND: But what IS asylum?
en: SIGMUND: But what IS asylum?
ja: シグムンド: だが、避難所とは一体何なのか?

key: It is all too often misunderstood as mere containment-- a dirty place, where those unfit to linger in the throes of society are swept away instead.
en: It is all too often misunderstood as mere containment-- a dirty place, where those unfit to linger in the throes of society are swept away instead.
ja: それはあまりにもしばしば、単なる収容施設だと誤解される――社会の苦しみの中に留まるにふさわしくない者たちが、代わりに掃き捨てられる、汚らわしい場所だと。

key: ELIZABETH: He wishes it were so.
en: ELIZABETH: He wishes it were so.
ja: エリザベス: そうであってほしいと、彼は願ってるだけ。

key: SIGMUND: But that is not the case at all.
en: SIGMUND: But that is not the case at all.
ja: シグムンド: だが、それは全く事実ではない。

key: Down to its roots-- the Greek "asylon", meaning "refuge", that itself from "asylos"-- "a safe place, protecting those inside from violence and harm."
en: Down to its roots-- the Greek "asylon", meaning "refuge", that itself from "asylos"-- "a safe place, protecting those inside from violence and harm."
ja: 語源をたどれば――ギリシャ語の「アシュロン」、意味は「避難」。それはさらに「アシュロス」から来ている――「暴力や害から中にいる者を守る、安全な場所」。

key: ELIZABETH: He explains it with words he doesn't understand to make it seem like he knows them.
en: ELIZABETH: He explains it with words he doesn't understand to make it seem like he knows them.
ja: エリザベス: 自分でもわかってない言葉を使って、わかってるふりをしてるだけ。

key: SIGMUND: Rest assured, children, no harm will come to you here.
en: SIGMUND: Rest assured, children, no harm will come to you here.
ja: シグムンド: 安心しなさい、子供たちよ、ここでは君たちに危害が及ぶことはない。

key: ELIZABETH: Nothing he perceives as harm.
en: ELIZABETH: Nothing he perceives as harm.
ja: エリザベス: 彼が「危害」だと認識しないもの、ってだけ。

key: You are not safe.
en: You are not safe.
ja: あなたたちは安全じゃない。

key: SIGMUND: Not that you would even understand my saying so through your snivelling.
en: SIGMUND: Not that you would even understand my saying so through your snivelling.
ja: シグムンド: もっとも、そのすすり泣きの中で、私の言葉を理解できるとも思えないがね。

key: Pah.
en: Pah.
ja: フン。

key: ELIZABETH: Please, run away.
en: ELIZABETH: Please, run away.
ja: エリザベス: お願い、逃げて。

key: SIGMUND: You'll see in time, you have nothing to be afraid of.
en: SIGMUND: You'll see in time, you have nothing to be afraid of.
ja: シグムンド: そのうちわかる、恐れるものは何もない。

key: ELIZABETH: Run away!
en: ELIZABETH: Run away!
ja: エリザベス: 逃げて!

key: CHARLOTTE: Got Nostra back.
en: CHARLOTTE: Got Nostra back.
ja: シャルロット: ノストラ、取り返してきたよ。

key: Sorry if she smells like cake batter.
en: Sorry if she smells like cake batter.
ja: ケーキの生地みたいな匂いがしたらごめん。

key: No points for guessing why she does.
en: No points for guessing why she does.
ja: 理由を当てても何ももらえないけどね。

key: I tried to wash her off as best I could, but she was halfway in the oven by the time Lin finally stopped kicking.
en: I tried to wash her off as best I could, but she was halfway in the oven by the time Lin finally stopped kicking.
ja: できるだけ洗ってあげようとしたんだけど、リンがようやく暴れるのをやめた頃には、もうオーブンに半分入ってたから。

key: You know what she was gonna use for "frosting"?
en: You know what she was gonna use for "frosting"?
ja: 何を「フロスティング」に使うつもりだったか、わかる?

key: Mustard.
en: Mustard.
ja: マスタード。

key: Well, that's not an issue anymore.
en: Well, that's not an issue anymore.
ja: まあ、それはもう問題なくなったけど。

key: The orderlies will have to buy more before she can think about that again.
en: The orderlies will have to buy more before she can think about that again.
ja: 次に同じことを考える前に、看護助手たちがまた買い足さないといけないだろうね。

key: Lin's currently washing it off of herself.
en: Lin's currently washing it off of herself.
ja: リンは今、自分についたのを洗い流してる最中。

key: You might wanna avoid the shower for a few days.
en: You might wanna avoid the shower for a few days.
ja: 数日はシャワーを避けた方がいいかもね。

key: RADOMUS: They'll be safe.
en: RADOMUS: They'll be safe.
ja: ラドマス: あの子たちは安全だ。

key: Safe from them.
en: Safe from them.
ja: あいつらからは安全だ。

key: Safe from me.
en: Safe from me.
ja: 私からも安全だ。

key: This is for the best, isn't it, my star?
en: This is for the best, isn't it, my star?
ja: これが一番いいんだろう、私の星よ?

key: They will have a good life.
en: They will have a good life.
ja: あの子たちはいい人生を送るだろう。

key: They will grow up happy, surrounded by other children.
en: They will grow up happy, surrounded by other children.
ja: 他の子供たちに囲まれて、幸せに育つだろう。

key: They are in the care of professionals.
en: They are in the care of professionals.
ja: 専門家の手に委ねられているのだから。

key: They will be happy.
en: They will be happy.
ja: あの子たちは幸せになるだろう。

key: And I...
en: And I...
ja: そして私は……

key: I suppose I have no shortage of time to reflect on it.
en: I suppose I have no shortage of time to reflect on it.
ja: それについて振り返る時間だけは、いくらでもあるようだ。

key: All the time in the world...
en: All the time in the world...
ja: この世のすべての時間が……

key: And for what, I wonder.
en: And for what, I wonder.
ja: 一体何のために、なのだろうな。

key: LUNA: It's not as if my own parents would ever accept me.
en: LUNA: It's not as if my own parents would ever accept me.
ja: ルナ: 実の両親が、わたくしを受け入れてくれることなど、ないでしょうから。

key: But wouldn't that be nice?
en: But wouldn't that be nice?
ja: でも、それも素敵なことなのではありませんこと?

key: Too much of this world is decided for us--
en: Too much of this world is decided for us--
ja: この世界のあまりに多くのことが、わたくしたちのために決められてしまいます――

key: Our names, our bodies, the people we live with.
en: Our names, our bodies, the people we live with.
ja: 名前も、体も、一緒に暮らす人々も。

key: Too much is treated as sacred on such an arbitrary basis.
en: Too much is treated as sacred on such an arbitrary basis.
ja: あまりに多くのことが、そんな恣意的な根拠のまま、神聖なものとして扱われているのです。

key: Who are you really?
en: Who are you really?
ja: あなたは本当は、誰なのでしょうか?

key: How much of that was decided for you?
en: How much of that was decided for you?
ja: そのうちのどれだけが、あなたのために決められたものなのでしょう?

key: I, for one, am ill-content to be a person who has had her choices made for her.
en: I, for one, am ill-content to be a person who has had her choices made for her.
ja: 少なくともわたくしは、自分の選択を他人に決められる人間でいることには、不満でございます。

key: It is my life, after all.
en: It is my life, after all.
ja: 結局のところ、これはわたくしの人生ですから。

key: All I need to do is find someone who has room in their heart for that.
en: All I need to do is find someone who has room in their heart for that.
ja: あとは、そのための余地を心に持ってくださる方を見つけるだけです。

key: So, you say you know just the person?
en: So, you say you know just the person?
ja: で、ちょうどいい方をご存じだと?

key: LAURA: Anna, would you like to join us?
en: LAURA: Anna, would you like to join us?
ja: ローラ: アンナ、一緒にどう?

key: I'm leading art therapy today.
en: I'm leading art therapy today.
ja: 今日はアートセラピーを担当してるの。

key: Maybe you can help your brother figure out something to draw.
en: Maybe you can help your brother figure out something to draw.
ja: 弟くんが何を描くか決めるの、手伝ってあげたら?

key: Charlotte's just finishing up, I think.
en: Charlotte's just finishing up, I think.
ja: シャルロットはもうすぐ終わると思うわ。

key: She drew herself as the singer of a-- rock band?
en: She drew herself as the singer of a-- rock band?
ja: 自分をロックバンドの――ボーカルとして描いてるみたい?

key: Oh, death metal........
en: Oh, death metal........
ja: あら、デスメタル……

key: My mistake........
en: My mistake........
ja: 失礼しました……

key: Um, well, as long as you find it therapeutic........
en: Um, well, as long as you find it therapeutic........
ja: まあ、その、あなたにとって癒やしになってるなら……

key: And Lin, what've you got?
en: And Lin, what've you got?
ja: で、リンは何を描いたの?

key: I meant for your drawing--
en: I meant for your drawing--
ja: あなたの絵の話をしてたんだけど――

key: L-Lin, please draw on your OWN paper!
en: L-Lin, please draw on your OWN paper!
ja: リ、リン、自分の紙に描いてね!

key: Ah, what've you done to Londa's portrait?!
en: Ah, what've you done to Londa's portrait?!
ja: あ、ロンダの肖像画に何したの?!

key: That was supposed to be of her mother!
en: That was supposed to be of her mother!
ja: それ、お母さんを描いたものだったのに!

key: Is that a-- ?!
en: Is that a-- ?!
ja: それって――?!

key: Lin, I'm sorry; I have to report this to the Doctor.
en: Lin, I'm sorry; I have to report this to the Doctor.
ja: リン、ごめんなさい、これはドクターに報告しなきゃ。

key: P-please, let me g-- Ow!
en: P-please, let me g-- Ow!
ja: は、放して――いたっ!

key: SAPHIRA: Denied.
en: SAPHIRA: Denied.
ja: サファイラ: 却下。

key: Again.
en: Again.
ja: またしても

key: Because apparently I create an "unstable living environment."
en: Because apparently I create an "unstable living environment."
ja: だって、あたしは「不安定な生活環境」を作り出すらしいから。

key: As if this place isn't already, at any given time, a hellfuck stye of chaos.
en: As if this place isn't already, at any given time, a hellfuck stye of chaos.
ja: まるでこの場所が、どんな時だってクソみたいなカオスの豚小屋じゃないみたいに言うよね。

key: And half of that, just because of that girl--
en: And half of that, just because of that girl--
ja: で、その半分は、ただあの子のせいで――

key: He'd rather Laura be around someone who actively torments her than her own sister who would do any single thing on the entire planet for her.
en: He'd rather Laura be around someone who actively torments her than her own sister who would do any single thing on the entire planet for her.
ja: あの人は、ローラのために世界中のどんなことでもしてやる実の姉より、積極的にローラをいじめるようなやつをそばに置いておく方がいいらしいの。

key: And the whole legal system is behind him on it because of some stupid pieces of paper.
en: And the whole legal system is behind him on it because of some stupid pieces of paper.
ja: で、法制度全体が、くだらない紙切れのせいで、あの人の味方をしてるってわけ。

key: What a fucking joke.
en: What a fucking joke.
ja: まったく、クソみたいな冗談よね。

key: ???: And even though it disappeared from the world forever, do you know what that little meteor did?
en: ???: And even though it disappeared from the world forever, do you know what that little meteor did?
ja: ???: そして、その小さな流れ星が世界から永遠に消えてしまったとしても、それがどうしたか知ってる?

key: It lived happily ever after,
en: It lived happily ever after,
ja: その後もずっと幸せに生きたの、

key: In the joy it brought, and the hearts it touched, and the smiles it inspired in its final moments as a shooting star.
en: In the joy it brought, and the hearts it touched, and the smiles it inspired in its final moments as a shooting star.
ja: 流れ星としての最後の瞬間に、もたらした喜びの中で、触れた心の中で、呼び起こした笑顔の中で。

key: So even with its last little itty bitty bit of life,
en: So even with its last little itty bitty bit of life,
ja: だから、そのほんのちっちゃな最後の命でさえ、

key: It never, ever regretted what it had done, even once.
en: It never, ever regretted what it had done, even once.
ja: 自分のしたことを、一度たりとも後悔なんてしなかったの。

key: So, make sure to smile for me too, okay?
en: So, make sure to smile for me too, okay?
ja: だから、あなたもあたしの分まで、ちゃんと笑ってね、いい?

key: Even when mommy's gone...
en: Even when mommy's gone...
ja: ママがいなくなっても……

key: You understand why mommy has to go, right?
en: You understand why mommy has to go, right?
ja: ママが行かなきゃいけない理由、わかるよね?

key: I'm sure...
en: I'm sure...
ja: きっと……

key: You'll understand, my little meteorite...
en: You'll understand, my little meteorite...
ja: わかってくれるよね、あたしの小さないん石ちゃん……

key: Please forgive me...
en: Please forgive me...
ja: 許してね……

key: MR.SHADOW: Just one sacrifice?
en: MR.SHADOW: Just one sacrifice?
ja: ミスター・シャドウ: たった一つの犠牲?

key: To save the whole world?
en: To save the whole world?
ja: 世界全体を救うために?

key: Or give it another chance-- sure, whatever.
en: Or give it another chance-- sure, whatever.
ja: それとも、もう一度チャンスを与える――まあ、何でもいいけど。

key: You're missing the point.
en: You're missing the point.
ja: 論点がずれてる。

key: The time for holding onto your ideals passed well before that boy suffocated.
en: The time for holding onto your ideals passed well before that boy suffocated.
ja: お前が理想にしがみついていられる時間は、あの少年が窒息するよりずっと前に終わっていたんだ。

key: We were too busy lying to ourselves to see it.
en: We were too busy lying to ourselves to see it.
ja: 俺たちは自分を欺くのに忙しすぎて、それに気づかなかった。

key: Let's not make the same mistake twice.
en: Let's not make the same mistake twice.
ja: 同じ過ちを二度繰り返すのはやめよう。

key: Everyone's lives versus one person's?
en: Everyone's lives versus one person's?
ja: みんなの命 対 一人の命?

key: It's a no-brainer if you would set emotion out of this.
en: It's a no-brainer if you would set emotion out of this.
ja: 感情を抜きにすれば、考えるまでもないことだ。

key: ...Look.
en: ...Look.
ja: ……いいか。

key: Use me-- I'm volunteering.
en: Use me-- I'm volunteering.
ja: 俺を使え――自分から志願してるんだ。

key: You know I don't even like this body.
en: You know I don't even like this body.
ja: この体、そもそも好きじゃないって知ってるだろ。

key: In that respect, you'd be doing me a favor.
en: In that respect, you'd be doing me a favor.
ja: その点では、お前は俺に恩を売ることになる。

key: Still not good enough?
en: Still not good enough?
ja: それでもまだ足りないか?

key: Fine, I'll take the guilt off your shoulders.
en: Fine, I'll take the guilt off your shoulders.
ja: わかった、その罪悪感、俺が肩代わりしてやる。

key: One step over this rail and I'd fall to my death anyway.
en: One step over this rail and I'd fall to my death anyway.
ja: この手すりを一歩越えれば、どのみち俺は落ちて死ぬ。

key: I'm going to do it.
en: I'm going to do it.
ja: 俺はやるぞ。

key: I don't want to stay in a world where we threw down our hands and gave up before the fight was even over.
en: I don't want to stay in a world where we threw down our hands and gave up before the fight was even over.
ja: 戦いが終わる前に手を投げ出して諦めた世界になんて、いたくない。

key: So, either you let this happen, or you make the tough choice to do something about it.
en: So, either you let this happen, or you make the tough choice to do something about it.
ja: だから、このまま起こるに任せるか、それとも何かするための厳しい選択をするか、どっちかだ。

key: Use my life.
en: Use my life.
ja: 俺の命を使え。

key: It's the logical decision.
en: It's the logical decision.
ja: それが論理的な決断だ。

key: Whatever happens, just stop Lin.
en: Whatever happens, just stop Lin.

key: THIRD: She must not take action, or you will fail.
en: THIRD: She must not take action, or you will fail.
ja: サード: 彼女に行動させるな、さもなくば失敗する。

key: Your pawn must be promoted, or you will fail.
en: Your pawn must be promoted, or you will fail.
ja: お前の駒は昇格させねばならぬ、さもなくば失敗する。

key: You must support \PN, or you will fail.

ja: \PNを支援せねばならぬ、さもなくば失敗する。

key: This outcome is unalterable.
en: This outcome is unalterable.
ja: この結末は変えられない。

key: This outcome is left to random chance.
en: This outcome is left to random chance.
ja: この結末は偶然に委ねられている。

key: This outcome cannot be foreseen.
en: This outcome cannot be foreseen.

key: You must correct the timeline, or you will fail.

key: This outcome can only be decided by another.
en: This outcome can only be decided by another.

key: You must not speak to \PN, or you will fail.
en: You must not speak to \PN, or you will fail.
ja: \PNに話しかけてはならぬ、さもなくば失敗する。

key: No remaining options lead to favorable outcomes.
en: No remaining options lead to favorable outcomes.
ja: 残された選択肢のいずれも、望ましい結末には至らない。

key: NOEL: Anna, if we stay here, we're going to get caught...
en: NOEL: Anna, if we stay here, we're going to get caught...
ja: ノエル: アンナ、ここにいたら見つかっちゃうよ……

key: ANNA: Not if you stay quiet!
en: ANNA: Not if you stay quiet!
ja: アンナ: 静かにしてれば大丈夫!

key: Check under the ice machine! Maybe they're there.
en: Check under the ice machine! Maybe they're there.
ja: 製氷機の下、見てみて! そこにあるかも。

key: NOEL: There's... frozen yogurt tubes.
en: NOEL: There's... frozen yogurt tubes.
ja: ノエル: これは……フローズンヨーグルトのチューブだよ。

key: ANNA: No, it has to be the popsicles! Gelly said they're the only thing that helps his throat not burn!
en: ANNA: No, it has to be the popsicles! Gelly said they're the only thing that helps his throat not burn!
ja: アンナ: 違う、アイスキャンディーのはずなの! ジェリーが、喉の痛みを和らげるのはそれしかないって言ってたから!

en: NOEL: Anna, there's no popsicles here.

key: ANNA: Here, let me see...
en: ANNA: Here, let me see...

key: NOEL: We should go back.
en: NOEL: We should go back.
ja: ノエル: 戻った方がいいよ。

key: ANNA: I promised Gelly we'd get them; we're not giving up!
en: ANNA: I promised Gelly we'd get them; we're not giving up!
ja: アンナ: ジェリーに、絶対持っていくって約束したの。諦めない!

key: NOEL: The orderlies are going to be here any second.
en: NOEL: The orderlies are going to be here any second.
ja: ノエル: 看護助手たちが、もうすぐ来るよ。

key: MR. SHADOW: Ramsey just lit up a second smoke.
en: MR. SHADOW: Ramsey just lit up a second smoke.
ja: ミスター・シャドウ: ラムジーがちょうど二本目のタバコに火をつけたところだ。

key: You have at least five more minutes.
en: You have at least five more minutes.
ja: あと少なくとも五分はある。

key: NOEL: Let's go already.
en: NOEL: Let's go already.
ja: ノエル: もう行こうよ。

key: ANNA: Weren't you listening?! Nomos just said we still have time!
en: ANNA: Weren't you listening?! Nomos just said we still have time!
ja: アンナ: 聞いてなかったの?! ノモスが、まだ時間あるって言ったばっかりじゃん!

key: NOEL: Nomos... also says we should go.
en: NOEL: Nomos... also says we should go.
ja: ノエル: ノモスは……戻った方がいいとも言ってるよ。

key: Nomos is getting worried.
en: Nomos is getting worried.
ja: ノモスが心配しはじめてる。

key: MR.SHADOW: I hate when he does this.
en: MR.SHADOW: I hate when he does this.

key: Wait, Charity is making rounds.
en: Wait, Charity is making rounds.
ja: 待て、チャリティが見回りに来てる。

key: Stay quiet as she walks by.
en: Stay quiet as she walks by.
ja: 通り過ぎるまで、静かにしてろ。

key: NOEL: Okay, you can get in trouble yourself.
en: NOEL: Okay, you can get in trouble yourself.
ja: ノエル: わかった、自分で勝手にしかられてよ。

key: I'm going back to bed.
en: I'm going back to bed.
ja: 僕はベッドに戻る。

key: ANNA: Wait, not now, someone's coming!
en: ANNA: Wait, not now, someone's coming!
ja: アンナ: 待って、今はだめ、誰か来る!

key: NOEL: I don't hear anyone.
en: NOEL: I don't hear anyone.
ja: ノエル: 誰も聞こえないけど。

key: ANNA: Nom-- Uh, Nostra says there's someone coming right now! You have to stay quiet!
en: ANNA: Nom-- Uh, Nostra says there's someone coming right now! You have to stay quiet!
ja: アンナ: ノモ――えっと、ノストラが、今誰か来てるって言ってる! 静かにして!

key: NOEL: I'm going.
en: NOEL: I'm going.
ja: ノエル: 行くよ。

key: ORDERLY: What's that sound?
en: ORDERLY: What's that sound?

key: You there, Noel!
en: You there, Noel!

key: Anna, too?
en: Anna, too?

key: LIN: okay so let's say i believe you.
en: LIN: okay so let's say i believe you.
ja: リン: よし、じゃあ、あんたのこと信じるとするよ。

key: somehow, i'm just magically dripping wet all the time.
en: somehow, i'm just magically dripping wet all the time.

key: right?
en: right?

key: which means, everywhere i go, i should be getting everything ELSE wet too, right?
en: which means, everywhere i go, i should be getting everything ELSE wet too, right?
ja: ってことは、あたしがどこ行っても、他の全部もぬれちゃうはずだよね?

key: so let's play a game.
en: so let's play a game.
ja: じゃあ、ゲームしよっか。

key: you know it already--
en: you know it already--
ja: もう知ってるでしょ――

key: hide and seek, and you're "it".
en: hide and seek, and you're "it".
ja: かくれんぼ、あんたが鬼ね。

key: now if i'm really somehow dripping wet, then i'll just leave a moist trail of gross, sloshy wetness everywhere when i try to hide, right?
en: now if i'm really somehow dripping wet, then i'll just leave a moist trail of gross, sloshy wetness everywhere when i try to hide, right?
ja: もし本当にあたしがびしょぬれなら、隠れようとするたびに、気持ち悪くてびちゃびちゃしたぬれた跡を、そこら中に残すはずだよね?

key: so you'll find me immediately, right?
en: so you'll find me immediately, right?
ja: だから、すぐ見つかるはずでしょ?

key: yeah, i didn't think so.
en: yeah, i didn't think so.
ja: まあ、そうはならないと思ってたけど。

key: just admit you're a liar already.
en: just admit you're a liar already.

key: ARCEUS: Arcaaa!
en: ARCEUS: Arcaaa!
ja: アルセウス: アルカァァ!

key: Out cold...
en: Out cold...
ja: 気を失っている……

key: ANNA: \PN...?
en: ANNA: \PN...?
ja: アンナ: \PN……?

key: You're...
en: You're...
ja: あなた……

key: You're not glowing anymore...
en: You're not glowing anymore...
ja: もう、光ってない……

key: ANNA: Arceus is gone...
en: ANNA: Arceus is gone...
ja: アンナ: アルセウスがいなくなった……

key: And you're not glowing...
en: And you're not glowing...
ja: それに、あなたも光ってない……

key: It's really you, isn't it?
en: It's really you, isn't it?
ja: 本当に、あなたなんだよね?

key: Not Lin,
en: Not Lin,
ja: リンじゃなくて、

key: But you?
en: But you?
ja: あなたなんだよね?

key: ANNA: I've--
en: ANNA: I've--
ja: アンナ: あたし――

key: I've made such a terrible mistake...
en: I've made such a terrible mistake...
ja: とんでもない間違いを犯しちゃった……

key: I thought-- I thought you were--
en: I thought-- I thought you were--
ja: 思ってた――あなたのことを、その――

key: I thought she was--
en: I thought she was--

key: ...It was you all along.
en: ...It was you all along.
ja: ……ずっと、あなただったんだね。

key: Lin is really gone, isn't she?
en: Lin is really gone, isn't she?
ja: リンは本当に、もういないんだよね?

key: But I fought so hard-- against you--
en: But I fought so hard-- against you--

key: I thought, I had lost-- it was hopeless--
en: I thought, I had lost-- it was hopeless--
ja: 負けたと思ってた――もう望みはないって――

key: And in the end...
en: And in the end...
ja: 結局……

key: I just made things worse--
en: I just made things worse--
ja: 事態を悪化させただけ――

key: Even worse than she did...
en: Even worse than she did...
ja: あいつよりも、もっと悪く……

key: ANNA: Hey, \PN...
en: ANNA: Hey, \PN...
ja: アンナ: ねえ、\PN……

key: Have you heard that phrase,
en: Have you heard that phrase,
ja: こういう言葉、聞いたことある?

key: "Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by incompetence"?
en: "Never attribute to malice that which is adequately explained by incompetence"?
ja: 「無能で十分説明がつくことに、悪意を見出すな」って。

key: It makes it sound like mere incompetence isn't so bad...
en: It makes it sound like mere incompetence isn't so bad...
ja: なんか、無能なだけなら大したことないみたいに聞こえるけど……

key: But right now, I'm wondering...
en: But right now, I'm wondering...
ja: でも今、思うの……

key: Is that really any better?
en: Is that really any better?
ja: それって、本当にマシなことなのかな?

key: If someone does something bad, is it better for them to do it out of malice, or incompetence?
en: If someone does something bad, is it better for them to do it out of malice, or incompetence?
ja: 誰かが悪いことをするとして、悪意からするのと、無能からするのと、どっちがマシなんだろう?

key: ANNA: I think you're right.
en: ANNA: I think you're right.
ja: アンナ: あなたの言う通りだと思う。

key: Because then it's simple.
en: Because then it's simple.
ja: だって、そうすれば単純だから。

key: All anyone had to do was stop them.
en: All anyone had to do was stop them.
ja: 誰かがそいつを止めればよかっただけ。

key: All they had to do was choose not to be evil.
en: All they had to do was choose not to be evil.
ja: 悪にならないって選ぶだけでよかった。

key: It's easy.
en: It's easy.
ja: 簡単。

key: ...So in the end, I only made things worse.
en: ...So in the end, I only made things worse.
ja: ……だから結局、あたしは事態を悪化させただけ。

key: I shouldn't have tried so hard to stop Lin.
en: I shouldn't have tried so hard to stop Lin.
ja: リンを止めようと、あんなに必死になるべきじゃなかった。

key: I should've just spent time with Noel, and with my dad.
en: I should've just spent time with Noel, and with my dad.
ja: ノエルや、パパと一緒に時間を過ごせばよかった。

en: People who were still around to care--

key: Instead, I gave myself to the person I hated most.
en: Instead, I gave myself to the person I hated most.
ja: それなのに、あたしは一番憎んでた相手に自分をささげちゃった。

key: I thought I was doing the right thing, but I just became like her.
en: I thought I was doing the right thing, but I just became like her.
ja: 正しいことをしてるつもりだったのに、結局あいつみたいになっちゃった。

key: ANNA: ...I don't think I agree.
en: ANNA: ...I don't think I agree.
ja: アンナ: ……それは違うと思う。

key: Because, then, what is anyone supposed to do about that?
en: Because, then, what is anyone supposed to do about that?
ja: だって、それなら一体みんな、どうすればいいの?

key: The world is already full of people who are trying their best...
en: The world is already full of people who are trying their best...
ja: 世界にはもう、精一杯頑張ってる人たちであふれてるのに……

key: Maybe more people like me--
en: Maybe more people like me--
ja: たぶん、あたしみたいな人がもっと増えるだけ――

key: People who tried so, so, so hard, and still only made things worse.
en: People who tried so, so, so hard, and still only made things worse.
ja: すごく、すごく、すごく頑張ったのに、それでも事態を悪化させただけの人たちが。

key: If that's the case, what is anyone supposed to do?
en: If that's the case, what is anyone supposed to do?
ja: もしそうなら、一体みんな何をすればいいの?

key: Are we just doomed, as people, to be causing problems for ourselves and everyone else around us forever?
en: Are we just doomed, as people, to be causing problems for ourselves and everyone else around us forever?
ja: あたしたちは人間として、ずっと自分自身と周りのみんなに問題を引き起こし続ける運命なの?

key: Because we can't help but be better?
en: Because we can't help but be better?
ja: もっとよくなろうとせずにはいられないから?

key: But it's kind of you to say so.
en: But it's kind of you to say so.
ja: でも、そう言ってくれるのは優しいね。

key: If that's really what you think,
en: If that's really what you think,
ja: 本当にそう思ってくれてるなら、

key: I'll try my best to believe it.
en: I'll try my best to believe it.
ja: 精一杯、信じてみる。

key: ANNA: \PN?
en: ANNA: \PN?

key: I'm sorry.
en: I'm sorry.
ja: 「ごめんなさい。

key: I'm so, so sorry--
en: I'm so, so sorry--
ja: 本当に、本当にごめんなさい――

key: ANNA: i think,
en: ANNA: i think,
ja: アンナ: あたし、思うんだけど、

key: i can find it in my heart to forgive you.
en: i can find it in my heart to forgive you.
ja: あんたのこと、許せる気がする。

key: i think it would be really easy, even.
en: i think it would be really easy, even.
ja: 案外簡単にできる気さえする。

key: i get it.
en: i get it.
ja: わかるよ。

key: you're hurt, you're scared,
en: you're hurt, you're scared,
ja: あんたは傷ついてて、怖がってて、

key: you were left all alone in this world and even the people who were supposed to take care of you couldn't be paid enough to do it well.
en: you were left all alone in this world and even the people who were supposed to take care of you couldn't be paid enough to do it well.
ja: この世界に一人きりで放っておかれて、面倒を見るはずだった人たちだって、まともにやるだけの見返りも与えられなかった。

key: it was the same for me too, you know?
en: it was the same for me too, you know?
ja: あたしも同じだったんだよ、知ってた?

key: we had a lot in common in the first place.
en: we had a lot in common in the first place.
ja: そもそも、あたしたちには共通点がたくさんあった。

key: that's why i didn't really mind playing with you from time to time.
en: that's why i didn't really mind playing with you from time to time.
ja: だから、時々あんたと遊ぶのも、そんなに嫌じゃなかったんだよね。

key: ...but you always took it too far.
en: ...but you always took it too far.
ja: ……でも、あんたはいつもやりすぎるの。

key: every single time.
en: every single time.
ja: 毎回、必ず。

ja: で、その中で一番の例が何だったか、わかる?

key: ANNA: HIM.
en: ANNA: HIM.
ja: アンナ: あいつ。

key: if you keep going through enough timelines, eventually they're going to get samey.
en: if you keep going through enough timelines, eventually they're going to get samey.
ja: 十分な数の時間軸を通り抜け続けたら、いずれ全部似たり寄ったりになっていく。

key: like how in chess, the game is a stalemate if you make the same move so many times.
en: like how in chess, the game is a stalemate if you make the same move so many times.
ja: チェスで、同じ手を何度も繰り返すとステイルメイトになるのと同じ。

key: nobody wants that.
en: nobody wants that.
ja: 誰もそんなの望んでない。

key: that's only going to drive everyone involved cosmically insane.
en: that's only going to drive everyone involved cosmically insane.
ja: 関わった全員を、宇宙規模で頭おかしくさせるだけ。

key: so, the way nostra explained it, there's a failsafe for that.
en: so, the way nostra explained it, there's a failsafe for that.
ja: で、ノストラが説明してくれたところによると、それに対するフェイルセーフがあるんだって。

key: in order to go back, something has to be sacrificed.

ja: 元に戻すためには、何かを犠牲にしなきゃいけない。

key: someone.

key: something to change the new timeline.
en: something to change the new timeline.
ja: 新しい時間軸を変えるための何かを。

key: make sure it won't happen the same way twice.
en: make sure it won't happen the same way twice.
ja: 同じことが二度と同じようには起きないように。

key: you were the one who forced me to do this.
en: you were the one who forced me to do this.

key: YOU MADE ME DO THIS TO HIM.

ja: あんたが、あたしにあいつへこれをやらせたんだ。

key: always weighing on me.

key: just like it always has been.

key: no one else can stop you, clearly.
